versions.changelog:
- Initial release of AI视频脚本生成器 (ai-video-script).
- Generates complete video scripts from a theme or keyword, including shot breakdowns, AI image/video prompts, and voiceover copy.
- Supports both short-form (15–60 seconds) and long-form (1–5 minutes) video scripts.
- Offers templates, prompt format guidelines for major AI tools (CogVideoX, Midjourney, SD), and sample scripts.
- Includes advanced features like batch generation, style customization, and duration adaptation for popular video platforms.
- Emphasizes copyright awareness, platform compliance, and practical usability.
